pr_title: br: increase the sleep time in the `waitForSend` function
pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #41210 

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?
When `Batcher.Len` reaches the threshold, it will call `asyncSend`, then call `Send` in `sendWorker`, and then call `RestoreBatch` to append `*ranges.RewriteRules` to `sender.rewriteRules`, the whole process may not be completed within 10ms, forming a flaky test(`require.True(t, sender.HasRewriteRuleOfKey("a"))` should be true, but false), so we need to increase the sleep time in the `waitForSend` function.
Note: `waitForSend` is only used for test.

review_comments: Do we need to set 50ms in the production and set 10ms in the test？ I am afraid that Too long timeout will affect CI.

@hawkingrei The `waitForSend` will be called 4 times in total, compared with the cost of unit-test fails, I think the cost of increasing the sleep time to 50ms is relatively small, but maybe we can double the sleep time, that is, 20ms.
The `waitForSend` is only used for test.
